pipeline._count: 24, not 5. ASIGetVideoData returns the OLDEST queued frame, so the frames right after ASIStartVideoCapture were still taken under the camera's PREVIOUS exposure/gain -- see the skip in asi_probe_grab() in asi_source.c. At count 5 this probe recorded nothing but those stale frames: the beam was invisible however bright it actually was, and the captures came out either flat-dark or flat-bright depending on what the last run had left set. find_roi averages only the tail of this file, so the extra frames are the discard budget.
